svg.title: Change of daily GPP against the change of air temperature from the 14 days before to the 14 days after, for control pairs without management (grey) and for fertilisation episodes (colour), per site.
svg.desc: Three scatter panels with the same axes. X axis: change of the mean air temperature, after minus before (°C). Y axis: change of the mean daily GPP, after minus before (g C m-2 d-1). Haltiala: 239 control pairs from 5 years, slope of the temperature-only fit 0.95 g C m-2 d-1 per °C (r = 0.63), 5 fertilisation episodes. Qvidja: 246 control pairs from 7 years, slope of the temperature-only fit 0.20 g C m-2 d-1 per °C (r = 0.43), 4 fertilisation episodes. Viikki: 68 control pairs from 4 years, slope of the temperature-only fit 0.20 g C m-2 d-1 per °C (r = 0.40), 5 fertilisation episodes. Over all 14 fertilisation episodes, the observed GPP change has a mean of −0.07 (SD 4.14) and the change that the weather fit (temperature and light) gives has a mean of 2.24 g C m-2 d-1. In all panels, the GPP change of the control pairs increases with the temperature change. 10 of the 14 fertilisation episodes are below the temperature-only fit line of their site.
